note: Icarus's light, laid over lighting.json while a character stands in Icarus (game/world/maps.h). MU draws no terrain here (MainScene.cpp:463): the road is additive cloud puffs (ZzzObject.cpp:3090-3169) over a navy clear colour, (3, 25, 44)/256 (SceneManager.cpp:385-386), lined by 180 pillar-arches, with no shadow anywhere and steady rain and silent lightning. So: a night above the clouds, the house's moonlit night taken literally. clear_colour (ours, the key is new with this sheet) is the frame wherever nothing is drawn, in linear light before the exposure; it is set so the void shows MU's navy, a sky and not a hole. A cool white-blue moon at the house 52 degrees; a navy sky fill; the bounce from below in the cloud's pale blue-grey, since the light under a pillar comes up off the cloud; a trace of navy dust for depth only; the shade cool, the light a touch warm (the house's little sepia, in the tints), saturation under 1 so the navy does not turn electric. No grass, no water. Invention on MU's look, docs/icarus-port.md B 6; first cut 2026-10-06.
